title: 第6章 原谅我们，大人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

随着蛮子老大在意外的枪响中重重倒地。

一场乱战也就随之展开。

虽然这儿是蛮子们的地盘，但那群三等人的突然袭击显然超出了他们的预估。

尤其是那个小头目还在躲闪中大骂了一句：

“不是叫你们收了他们的枪吗？他们为什么还有枪，为什么还有枪！！！”

是的，他们之前之所以一直没怎么防备这群三等人，就是因为他们是收了对方武器的。

不然他们可不敢让这么多人大摇大摆的走进自己的地盘。

甚至这也是蛮子老大一直忽视他们的唯一理由。

毕竟，没有枪且还在自己视线下的一群人能干什么呢？

可在这样一个鬼地方，显然没有任何人是善茬。

他们有自己的防备，但对方明显更加有想法和操作。

所以，随着意外的一枪打响，全然没想过会有来自三等人枪击的蛮子们，自然是一面倒了。

哪怕他们反应很快，可第一波里，他们倒下了太多人。

就寓乐粗略看到的，除开蛮子老大外，确认死亡的蛮子就足足七八个之多。

剩下的也多数带伤。

只有少数几个靠着幸运和机敏，狼狈的找着掩体试图反击。

外面的枪声也在大作。

显然，在寓乐看不到的地方有着另一场足以媲美当下的‘惊心动魄’。

来自四面八方的流弹不停的在寓乐耳边窜过。

这是一个现代人一辈子都遇不到的事情，甚至想来就算是那个自由的国家里，估计也没几个人能有寓乐的体验。

寓乐感觉自己的腿软的不行了，恐怕随时都可能瘫坐下去。

但他不能，因为他还要强撑着自己的‘体面’和‘身份’。

他本来就什么都没有，在被这个场面吓瘫，就算届时赢的是那群三等人，想来自己的处境也不会太好。

毕竟，那样一来，自己一是失去了不少威慑性。

二就是，照着前面的发展，寓乐担心这群三等人会害怕自己顾虑他们看到了贵族的‘狼狈’而回头下死手。

以至于好不容易逃出生天，又变回了之前的对峙。

当然，还有一个很重要的点就是，寓乐是在厂房中央，这儿没有任何掩体...

乱跑反而可能进入某个家伙的枪线，届时不管对方想不想杀了自己，自己都没命了。

所以，寓乐拿出了自己一生的镇定，在枪林弹雨之中，慢慢走过了蛮子老大的尸体。

等终于到了地方，才总算是松了一口气的瘫坐下去。

坐在沙发上，总比瘫倒在地上好吧...

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As the barbarian boss fell heavily to the ground amid the unexpected gunshots.

A chaotic battle ensued.

Although this is the territory of the barbarians, the sudden attack by the third-class people obviously exceeded their expectations.

Especially when the little boss cursed while dodging:

"Didn't I tell you to take away their guns? Why do they still have guns? Why do they still have guns!!!"

Yes, the reason why they didn't take much precaution against this group of third-class people before was because they had collected their opponent's weapons.

Otherwise, they would not dare to let so many people walk into their territory with such arrogance.

This is even the only reason why Boss Manzi has been ignoring them.

After all, what can a group of people do without guns and under their sight?

But in such a ghost place, it is obvious that no one is a good person.

They have their own defenses, but the other side is obviously more thoughtful and operational.

Therefore, when an unexpected shot was fired, the barbarians who had never expected that there would be a shot from the third class were naturally one-sided.

Even though they reacted quickly, too many people fell in the first wave.

As far as Yule could see, apart from the boss Manzi, there were only seven or eight Manzi who were confirmed dead.

Most of the rest were injured.

Only a few relied on luck and cleverness to find bunkers and try to fight back.

Gunfire was also raging outside.

Obviously, there is another 'thrilling' event that is comparable to the current one somewhere that Yule cannot see.

Stray bullets from all directions kept passing by Yule's ears.

This is something that modern people will never encounter in their lifetime. Even if you think about it, even in that free country, it is estimated that not many people can have the experience of entertainment.

Yule felt that his legs were so weak that he might collapse at any time.

But he can't, because he still has to hold on to his 'respect' and 'identity'.

He had nothing to begin with, but now that he was paralyzed by this scene, even if the winner was those third-class people, his situation would not be very good.

After all, in that case, he would lose a lot of his deterrence.

The second is that, based on the previous development, Yu Le is worried that these third-class people will be afraid of him and worry about them seeing the "embarrassment" of the nobles and turn around to kill them.

So much so that after finally escaping, it returned to the previous confrontation.

Of course, another very important point is that Yule is in the center of the factory, and there are no bunkers here...

If you run around, you may get into someone's line of fire. No matter whether the other person wants to kill you or not, you will be dead.

Therefore, Yule took out his lifelong calmness and slowly walked past the body of the barbarian boss amid the hail of bullets.

When he finally arrived, he finally sat down with a sigh of relief.

It's better to sit on the sofa than collapse on the floor...
